capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Motor Authority, per GM: 205 kWh usable (IEC 62660), 213 kWh (ISO 12405). GM TechLink says "approximately 200 kWh available" (used on the 2024 3X record).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 24-module Ultium NCMA pouch cells as the 2024 3X record (Weekly Driver); closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: GM TechLink (2022-04-14): about 400 V per layer, series for "800-volt DC fast charging". Treated as 800v like the 2024 records.

preconditioning.notes: GM TechLink (2022-04-14): "apps can precondition the battery". No automatic navigation trigger is documented for the 2022 truck on any page opened (the GM preconditioning guide returns 403), so manual_only; the 2024 3X record may differ.

dc_max_kw.notes: Motor Authority, per GM: 350 kW CCS; TechLink: up to 800 V/350 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs: "previous model year Hummers came with a standard 11.5 kW AC onboard charger" (19.2 kW starts 2024); Motor Authority 2022: 11.5 kW Level 2. Differs from the 2024 powertrains (19.2 kW).
